# Setup


```{r}
library(reticulate)

# Import Python modules into R variables
#py_install(c("arraylake))
py_install(c("arraylake")) 
xr   <- import("xarray")
np   <- import("numpy")
pd   <- import("pandas")
time <- import("time")

```

```{r}
# assign months, latitudes, and depths to filter
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
# 1. Load local NetCDF datasets using xarray
# depth is used to filter longitudinal extent
ds_depth <- xr$open_dataset("../STATIC/ocean_static.deptho.nc")

# 2. Connect to Earthmover Arraylake
client <- arraylake$Client()
repo <- client$get_repo("NOAA-PMEL/cefi-nep-hindcast-monthly")
session <- repo$readonly_session(branch = "main")

# Load aux group Zarr data
aux <- xr$open_zarr(session$store, zarr_format = 3L, group = "regrid/aux1")
# Use list() to match Python's double bracket [['MLD_003']] dataset subsetting
ds_mld <- aux[list("MLD_003")]
ds_temp = ds[['thetao']]
ds_xv = ds[['uo_rotate']]
ds_yv = ds[['vo_rotate']]
ds_ssh = ds[['ssh_rotate']]
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
# Ensure numpy is imported for the NaN checking block
np <- import("numpy", convert = FALSE)

print_ds_info <- function(dataset, var_name, nan_bool = FALSE) {
  
  # Access the variable array using standard R list indexing
  var_array <- dataset[[var_name]]
  
  # In Python, .size and .shape are attributes
  denominator <- py_to_r(var_array$size)
  shape <- py_to_r(var_array$shape)
  
  # Format shape into a clean string (e.g., "(12, 360, 720)")
  shape_str <- paste0("(", paste(shape, collapse = ", "), ")")
  
  cat(sprintf("%d records with dimensions %s\n", denominator, shape_str))
  
  if (nan_bool) {
    # Call NumPy's isfinite on the python data object
    # .sum() converts the boolean array to a count
    numerator <- py_to_r(np$isfinite(var_array$data)$sum())
    percent <- (numerator / denominator) * 100
    
    cat(sprintf("%d records (%.2f%%) are not np.nan\n", numerator, percent))
  }
  
  return(invisible(NULL))
}
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
py <- import_builtins()
var_dataset<-ds_mld
depth_dataset<-ds_depth
ds_var_name<-"MLD_003"
df_var_name<-"MLDegg"
df_var_name<-lifestage_dict[['egg']]
stage<-'egg'

annual_mean_2d <- function(var_dataset, depth_dataset, ds_var_name, df_var_name, filter_dict,stage, print_counts = TRUE) {
  
  # Start timer
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  cat(paste0("---", df_var_name, "---\n"))
  
  # Print initial info
  print_ds_info(var_dataset, ds_var_name, print_counts)
  
  # Merge files
  ds_merged <- xr$merge(list(var_dataset, depth_dataset))
  print_ds_info(ds_merged, ds_var_name, print_counts)
  
  # Create list with months (R vectors auto-convert to Python lists)
  month_list <- seq(filter_dict[[stage]][["min_month"]], filter_dict[[stage]][["max_month"]])
  
  # Select times and latitudes
  # Using xr$slice for slicing dimensions via reticulate
  ds_selected <- ds_merged$sel(
    time = ds_merged$time$dt$month$isin(month_list), 
    lat = py$slice(filter_dict[[stage]][["min_lat"]], filter_dict[[stage]][["max_lat"]])
  )
  print_ds_info(ds_selected, ds_var_name, print_counts)
  
  # Mask depths using bitwise AND (&) on the xarray DataArrays
  ds_masked <- ds_selected$where(
    (ds_selected$deptho >= filter_dict[[stage]][['min_depth']]) & (ds_selected$deptho <= filter_dict[[stage]][['max_depth']])
  )
  print_ds_info(ds_masked, ds_var_name, print_counts)
  
  # Calculate mean grouped by year
  # Dim parameter accepts an R vector which automatically passes as a Python list
  ds_mean <- ds_masked[[ds_var_name]]$groupby('time.year')$mean(dim = c('time', 'lon', 'lat'))
  
  # Create pandas dataframe and automatically convert it to an R data.frame
  # Setting convert = TRUE ensures it returns a native R data frame
  ds_df <- py_to_r(ds_mean$to_dataframe())
  
  # Rename column from dataset to dataframe variable name in R syntax
  names(ds_df)[names(ds_df) == ds_var_name] <- df_var_name
  
  # End timer and print runtime
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  runtime_minutes <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  cat(sprintf("Runtime: %.2f minutes\n", runtime_minutes))
  
  # Write output to CSV using standard R engine
  write.csv(ds_df, paste0("Output/hake_MOM6_", df_var_name, ".csv"), row.names = TRUE)
  
  return(ds_df)
}

```


```{r echo=FALSE}
MLDegg = annual_mean_2d(ds_mld, ds_depth, "MLD_003", "MLDegg", lifestage_dict, 'egg',TRUE)
```
